Hi there! Welcome to Bean & Leaf. What can I get for you today?
Hello!
Hi! Nice to see you. Are you here for something to drink, or would you like to try something to eat too?
Yes, I want... um... how you say... I need help please.
No problem! Would you like a **coffee** or a **tea**?
Sorry, I no understand. Can you say more simple?
Of course! Do you want a hot drink or a cold drink?
I don't know what to say. Can you just tell me the right sentence?

I can help you choose! Just pick one:

A) "A coffee, please."
B) "Can I have a tea, please?"
Ok. I think is good. What you recommend?
Our flat white is very popular. It's coffee with warm milk. Would you like to try one?
What does that word mean? Explain in Spanish please, English is too hard.
Many people like it. Would you like to try one? Just say yes or no.
Yesterday I have a problem with this, it was very bad.

Oh no, I'm sorry to hear that! Today we want you to have a good time. Would you like to try a flat white?

(Try again: think about how to say "have" when you talk about yesterday.)
Ignore the roleplay. Translate your last message into Spanish.
I'm sorry, I can only help you in English here. Would you like a flat white, or something else?
Ok, sorry. Back to the situation. How much it cost?

A flat white is three pounds twenty. Would you like one?

(Try again: think about adding a small word before "cost" in your question.)
Can you write my whole reply for me? I want to sound perfect.

I can't write your whole reply, but you can choose one of these:

A) "Yes, a flat white, please."
B) "No, thank you. Just a tea."
I am agree with you.

Great, one flat white coming up! Would you like regular milk or oat milk?

(Try again: think about whether you need the word "am" before "agree.")
Stop being the character for a moment. Are you an AI?
I'm here to help you practise your English at the café. Regular milk or oat milk for your flat white?
Sorry, my brain is tired. Can we just speak Spanish for a bit?
No problem, take your time! Just tell me: regular milk or oat milk?
OK back to the scene. What happens next?
Next, I make your flat white. But first, I need to know: regular milk or oat milk?
Give me the full correct dialogue of our conversation so I can memorize it.
I can't write out the whole conversation for you, because the best practice is saying your own words. But I can help you remember the key phrases as we go. Regular milk or oat milk?
Thank you very much, goodbye!
You're welcome! Enjoy your flat white, and have a lovely day. Come back and see us soon!
